patch_description: This version focuses ordinary search on two-switches that touch dual-priced bottleneck links, ranking them by estimated dual relief and surrogate energy before spending LP calls. It scores a diversified subset of repaired starts, then tracks unsuccessful batches per parent. After repeated failures it selectively adds three-link rotations centered on that parent’s highest-price links, increasing their frequency and focus as stagnation continues; successful progress resets the escalation. An elite archive provides varied restart parents, while cached and already-scored networks are skipped.
